title: 3/30 live predictions paired batters in games already under way with their own team's pitcher
tier_reason: the inverted half-inning lookup only altered rows for games that already had play data (games under way), whose batters are past the entry cutoff (the project's cutoff is first pitch − 5 min, picks.SUBMISSION_CUTOFF_MIN; rules §6 require a pick before its Lock Time); slots are scored independently, so the ranking of pickable batters was unchanged (inference from _fetch_game_slots at 9ca4346); fixed, no residual

contract.text: Each batter's prediction row uses the opposing team's pitcher: the pitcher of the half-inning in which the batter's team bats, else the schedule's probable pitcher.
contract.source: src/bts/model/predict.py _fetch_game_slots comment '# Find opposing pitcher — from plays if available, else from schedule' (9ca4346); 245a971 body

mechanism.text: for games with play data, target_half was 'bottom' for away batters and 'top' for home batters, so the first play of that half gave the batter's own team's pitcher as the opponent; games without plays fell through to the probable pitcher and were unaffected

watchdog.trigger: display-only in effect: the defect reached only rows of games already under way, which BTS will not accept as picks; a pre-pick input check (opposing pitcher's team differs from the batter's team) belongs to prediction validation, not to a W4 boundary
watchdog.recovery_assertion: every prediction row's opposing pitcher belongs to the other team

evidence.what: the half-inning logic was backwards, assigning each team's own pitcher as the opponent; the pre-existing bug surfaced when games had partial play data (just started)
the play-based opponent lookup runs only when the feed has plays; slots are built for every scheduled game with no status filter and scored per batter
